# openwrt_dhcp_srv (Resource)

A DNS SRV record (`config srvhost`).

Manages a `srvhost` section in `/etc/config/dhcp`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.
- `srv` (String) Service name, e.g. `_sip._tcp.example.lan`. (UCI option `srv`.)
- `target` (String) Target host. (UCI option `target`.)

### Optional

- `class` (Number) Priority. (UCI option `class`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `port` (Number) Port. (UCI option `port`.)
- `weight` (Number) Weight. (UCI option `weight`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
